common.style_usage: Stardew Valley pixel art: palette, outline weight (dark coloured, never black), shading and highlights

entries_stack.description: a small stack of three finished paintings on stretched canvases leaning back against each other on the ground, Stardew Valley pixel art, seen from the front and slightly above: the back canvas tallest, each one in front shorter and offset to the side, each showing a different little colourful painting (a blue sky landscape, an orange sunset, a flower still life), wooden stretcher edges with shading and highlights, a soft shadow at the base. Narrow and upright, filling the height. Transparent background.

entries_leaning.description: three small framed oil paintings propped upright and leaning against one another, Stardew Valley pixel art item: rounded warm-wood frames with highlights, colourful painted scenes inside (green hills, a sunset, a portrait), stacked front to back with the front one lowest, a little shadow under them. Compact and tall rather than wide. Transparent background.
